question: How many times in a year is the Bihu festival celebrated in Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Bihu is the official state festival of Assam, which is celebrated thrice a year.
 
• Bihu in Assam marks the three distinct phases of the farming calendar.
 
• Bihu is a secular festival that is celebrated by people from all parts of Assam irrespective of caste creed or religious background.
